description: The shared sentence requiring \(s\) predicate copies is true exactly when an injective tuple of \(s\) predicate elements exists.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.MonadicLogic.manyCopies_realize.{u_1} {M : Type u_1}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang 1).Structure M] (s : ℕ) :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.Entry.MonadicLogic.manyCopies s ↔
    ∃ a,
      (∀ (i : Fin s),
          FirstOrder.Language.Structure.RelMap (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.predicate 1 0) fun x => a i) ∧
        Function.Injective a
